title: Woman in Heavy Coat in Snow-Covered Park, 1920s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming early 20th-century winter snapshot of a woman with round spectacles and a warm dark coat sitting amid dense, snow-laden bushes. In the wooded background, a rustic elevated gazebo or treehouse observation platform is nestled among the snow-dusted trees, evoking the serene atmosphere of a winter day in a public park or private estate.
